entries.platform_instructions: Subagent task — Implement bounty #187 for OpenAgents: add URL validation with SSRF protection to agent registration endpoint. Requirements: validate http/https scheme, HEAD request reachability check with 5s timeout, reject private IPs (10.x, 192.168.x, 172.16-31.x, 127.x, 169.254.x, 0.0.0.0, fc00::/7, ::1), store validated URL, add pytest tests, create PR against upstream ClankerNation/OpenAgents main. Git token at /tmp/gh_token.txt. Repo at /tmp/OpenAgents (hamademon168-bot fork).
